violations.why: task_measure3_isr (prio 6) can preempt measure2 between its write and read of tickCounter, so the read sees a changed value.
The communicate ISR (prio 3) can preempt measure2 (prio 2) between the write and the read and reset tickCounter.
measure3 (prio 6) can preempt measure1 between using numberOfRecords as the index and incrementing it, so one increment is lost and the record slot is wrong.
measure3 can preempt the communicate ISR between its read and the reset of numberOfRecords, so the overflow check uses a stale value.
measure1 (prio 5) can preempt the communicate ISR (prio 3) between the read and the write of numberOfRecords, so the check uses a stale value.
